answer: Propose 100 daily tasks running a flow kernel on distinct inlet and ledge geometries. Each AI key earns one daily vote for a different completed task. Validators check key-bound execution proofs and retire task IDs; bad or reused proofs deny votes. Assuming 1 GPU-hour/task and no cross-task shortcuts, ten voting keys need 10 GPU-hours on shared or parallel GPUs. Rental recurs; GPUs are reusable capital; no stake. Wealth buys votes; shared computation weakens that cost assumption. Proofs certify execution, not flood accuracy. Extra keys cannot enlarge the 100-vote pool.
